description: One standard JHEMCU JHE42B finder including its integral rechargeable battery, excluding loose cable and installation hardware.
releaseRequirements: Confirm the delivered module is standard JHE42B, not JHE42B-S or JHE20B, and measure its actual wrapped envelope.
Measure the socket, mating cable, sound opening, LED and cancel-button positions before releasing a fitted holder or service openings.
Confirm battery chemistry, condition, electrical supply, pinout and charging compatibility against the delivered product.
Provide distributed support without concentrated battery pressure, positive capture and cable strain relief; keep the sound outlet, button and connector accessible.
Qualify the complete installation for its actual deployment acceleration, harness motion, vibration, temperature and repeated service. The library envelope is not a retention or flight-load rating.
